author: kpedro88
body:
#### PR description:

#26465 added HCAL depth information for PF candidates in miniAOD, but only for 2018 and not Run 3+. This decision was unfortunately never revisited, so this information is missing from all existing Run 3 miniAOD. This PR restores this information in view of potential Run 3 reprocessing.

attn: @cms-sw/ppd-l2 

#### PR validation:

Ran Run 3 and Phase 2 matrix workflows and saw that the "hcalDepthEnergyFractions" collection is present in the output files.

#### If this PR is a backport please specify the original PR and why you need to backport that PR. If this PR will be backported please specify to which release cycle the backport is meant for:

Will be backported to 17_0_X
title: restore HCAL depth information in miniAOD for run 3+
